name: FINVIZ_SCREENER_LOCK_RETRY_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: FINVIZ_SCREENER_LOCK_RETRY_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1577: a weekday-morning dispatch-burst run lost
screeners to a 3 s SQLSTATE 55P03 lock_timeout on watchlist_items and then stamped the whole run
status=failed, which n8n_output_verdict grades empty_output before it reads produced_count -- a run that
produced a large set of tickers was dead-lettered as an empty one. This gate pins the per-screener batch
lock wait, the bounded retry on 55P03 only, and a receipt whose status follows what the run produced.
